subject: Animation
title: Lighting: The Invisible Storyteller
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Lighting: The Invisible Storyteller.

hook.text: Pixar employs dedicated lighting artists whose job is to set the mood of every scene with virtual light.

buildup.text: Warm light signals safety and love. Cold light signals danger and isolation. Audiences feel the shift.

discovery.text: In Inside Out, each emotion's headquarters area uses a different color palette driven by lighting.

twist.text: A single shot might require lighting artists to place hundreds of virtual lights by hand.

climax.text: Lighting is invisible to most viewers, but it is one of the most emotionally powerful tools Pixar uses.

punchline.text: You never notice the light, but you always feel it.

quiz.question: How does lighting function as a storytelling tool at Pixar?
options: It is only used for technical realism
Warm and cold light signal emotional tone, guiding how audiences feel about each scene
Lighting is automated and requires no artistic input
